rows.text: copies `0x30`-byte records backward from the range `rcx` to `rdx` into the area ending at `r8`, moving each record's qword `+8` (read through a null guard), dword `+0x10`, byte `+0x14`, dword `+0x18` and qwords `+0x20` and `+0x28` but not its first qword, and returns the destination start; when `rdx` equals `rcx` it returns `r8` unchanged

copies `0x28`-byte records backward from the range `rcx` to `rdx` into the area ending at `r8`, moving each record's qword `+8`, dword `+0x10`, qword `+0x18` and byte `+0x20` but not its first qword, and returns the destination start; when `rdx` equals `rcx` it returns `r8` unchanged

copies `0x30`-byte records backward from the range `rcx` to `rdx` into the area ending at `r8`, moving each record's qword `+8` (read through a null guard) and the eight dwords `+0x10` to `+0x2C` but not its first qword, and returns the destination start; when `rdx` equals `rcx` it returns `r8` unchanged

copies `0x30`-byte records forward from the range `rcx` to `rdx` to `r8`, moving each record's qword `+8` (read through a null guard) and the eight dwords `+0x10` to `+0x2C` but not its first qword, and returns the destination end (`r8` itself when `rcx` equals `rdx`)

copies `0x218`-byte records forward from the range `rcx` to `rdx` to `r8`, moving each record's qword `+8`, the `0x200` bytes from `+0x10` two bytes per step over 256 steps, and qword `+0x210` but not its first qword, and returns the destination end (`r8` itself when `rcx` equals `rdx`)

copies `0x28`-byte records forward from the range `rcx` to `rdx` to `r8`, writing for each non-null destination record the template pointer `00908808` to its first qword and the source's qword `+8`, dword `+0x10`, qword `+0x18` and byte `+0x20`, and returns the destination end (`r8` itself when `rcx` equals `rdx`)

fills `edx` consecutive `0x30`-byte records from `rcx` (none when `edx` is zero) as copies of the record at `r8`: for each non-null slot it writes qword `+8` from the source (read through a null guard), the template pointer `009087A8` to the first qword, and the source's dword `+0x10`, byte `+0x14`, dword `+0x18` and qwords `+0x20` and `+0x28`
moves the 10-byte elements (a qword then a word) from `r8` up to the end qword `[rcx + 8]` down to `rdx`, then adds the signed `(rdx - r8) / 10 * 10` to qword `[rcx + 8]` and returns `rdx`

counts the 10-byte elements between qwords `[rcx]` and `[rcx + 8]` (signed divide by 10); when `edx` is above that count (unsigned) it calls `0021F130(rcx, [rcx + 8], edx - count, &zeroed 10-byte stack element)`, otherwise it tail-jumps `002207E0(rcx, [rcx] + edx * 10, [rcx + 8])`
calls `007A5F10(rcx + 8)`, then stores the template pointer `009087A8` to qword `[rcx]`, -1 to dword `+0x10`, 0 to dword `+0x18`, byte `+0x14` and qwords `+0x20` and `+0x28`, and returns `rcx`

calls `007A5F10(rcx + 8)`, then stores the template pointer `009087C0` to qword `[rcx]`, 0 to dwords `+0x10` and `+0x28`, -1 to qword `+0x14`, `0x7F` to dword `+0x1C`, `0x40` to dword `+0x20` and -1 to dword `+0x24`, and returns `rcx`

stores the template pointer `00908808` to qword `[rcx]` and 0 to qword `+8`, dword `+0x10` and byte `+0x20`, then stores to qword `+0x18` the result of an 11-byte wrapper that tail-jumps `malloc` with size `0x10000`, and returns `rcx`

stores the template pointer `009087E0` to qword `[rcx]` and 0 to qwords `+8` and `+0x210`, then stores to qword `+8` the result of an 11-byte wrapper that tail-jumps `malloc` with size `0x100000`, and returns `rcx`
